title: Cashback
whatsThisIntro: This App offers two ways to earn: clip coupons on your grocery shopping, or earn cashback shopping through partner links - both build toward the same claimable balance.
whatsThisCoupons: Pick a supermarket, clip coupons, then shop in-store or online to earn.
whatsThisCashback: Shop through partner links (AliExpress, NordVPN, and more) to earn a percentage back.
whatsThisClaim: Once your claimable balance is at or above the minimum, tap Claim to receive your Asset.
